title: One caravan, one market
note: Mansa Musa's hajj of 1324 and the Cairo gold price, on al-Umari's testimony twelve years later.

beats.text: A king of Mali crashed Egypt's gold price
Mansa Musa, king of Mali, in 1324

beats.callsub: a normal amount, at the normal price
carrying gold, and giving it away

beats.call: Too much gold in one city
beats.callsub: so gold in Cairo became cheap
the price had not come back up

beats.text: More of a thing makes it worth less
beats.sub: seen for real, seven hundred years ago

beats.text: An Egyptian official wrote it down
